Hospital Admission History and Physical
Date: 09/12/2026
Patient: Filiberto Ryan, 89 y/o M

Chief Complaint:
Back pain.

History of Present Illness:
Back pain since 08/25/2026 after lifting a laundry basket. No trauma reported. No radiation of pain.

Admission:
Adm 09/12/2026 intractable back pain, NRS 9/10 on IV opioids.

Past Medical History:
HTN, CAD, no prior spine surgery.

Physical Exam:
VS stable. Tenderness over lumbar spine. No motor deficit. Sensation intact. Reflexes normal.

Assessment:
Severe back pain, likely musculoskeletal etiology.

Plan:
Continue pain control. Monitor neurologic status. Imaging pending.

notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 09/11/2026
Patient: Filiberto Ryan, 89 y/o M

MRI of the thoracic spine performed.

MRI 09/11/2026: T12 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR.
No other acute fractures identified. No paraspinal soft tissue mass or abnormal enhancement.
No evidence of spinal canal stenosis or cord signal abnormality.

Impression:
T12 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury.
No additional acute findings.

notes.author: Interventional radiologist
notes.text:
Spine Intervention Consultation
Date: 09/14/2026
Patient: Filiberto Ryan, 89 y/o M

Hx: Pt presents with vertebral compression fracture.

Exam: Pain at fx level; afebrile, no infx signs.

Imaging: Recent MRI confirms acute compression fracture at T12.

Plan: Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program.

Intervention: Consider vertebroplasty pending bone density results and pt's clinical status.

Follow-up: Monitor for any new neuro deficits or signs of infection.
